title: 第291章 与奇美拉家族的冲突第290章 竞拍
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：穿越自带炼妖壶：桀桀，顷刻炼化第一卷：默认第291章与奇美拉家族的冲突（..la）第一艘湮灭星舰开始拍卖。
由于卖的只是建造计划，所以投影上只是放了几张照片。
就在众人准备摩拳擦掌大干一场的时候。
一道淡淡的声音传来了：
“五十万！”
说话的人正是荣耀帝国的外交总长哈维。
这仿佛给在座的众人头顶泼了一盆冷水。
荣耀帝国也要下场竞价，那还能有他们什么份。
关键是也不敢竞价啊。
他们可扛不住世界之主去自己家里串门。
就这样，拍卖会进入了一种诡异的氛围。
不过就算这样，拍卖还在进行。
拍卖师见没人竞价，也是开口报价：
“五十万一次！”
“五十万两次！”
“五十万三次！”
“成交！！！”
“恭喜荣耀帝国收下这座恢弘的湮灭星舰！相信它一定会为帝国开疆扩土！”
“下面我们来拍卖第二艘星舰！”
有了第一次的经历，这次下面的众人都有了心里准备。

果然荣耀帝国又出手了。
还是报价五十万。
依旧没人竞价，众人已经在想，难道他们要把所有的星舰全部包圆吗？
那这样还喊我们来干嘛？
但不管他们怎么想，拍卖依旧再继续。
第三艘、第四艘......第九艘。
好消息是荣耀帝国在第四艘的时候就收手了，不再进行任何报价。
坏消息是骑士联盟和商业联邦又来了。
这两家也是每一家拿下三艘。
也是以五十万的起拍价购得，没人和他们竞价。
到了第十艘的时候，众人已经在猜测。
下面会不会有所改变的时候，果然情况就和他们预料的一样。
三大势力都收手了。
魔法帝国作为星舰的一方研究者，早就包圆了第一批星舰的产出。
现在是作为这场拍卖会的组织者露面的。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Time Travel Comes with the Demon Refining Pot: Jie Jie, Instant Refining Volume 1: Default Chapter 291 Conflict with the Chimera Family (..la) The auction of the first Annihilation Starship begins.
Since what was sold was only the construction plan, only a few photos were displayed on the projection.
Just when everyone was gearing up for a big fight.
A faint voice came:
"Half a million!"
The person who spoke was none other than Harvey, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Glory Empire.
This seemed to pour cold water on everyone present.
The Glory Empire also wants to bid, so what share will they have?
The key is that I don’t dare to bid.
They can't bear the Lord of the World to visit their home.
In this way, the auction entered a strange atmosphere.
But even so, the auction is still going on.
When the auctioneer saw that no one was bidding, he also made an offer:
"Half a million at a time!"
"Half a million twice!"
"Three times five hundred thousand!"
"Deal!!!"
"Congratulations to the Glory Empire for accepting this magnificent Annihilation Starship! I believe it will definitely expand the territory of the Empire!"
"Let's auction the second starship!"
After this first experience, everyone below was mentally prepared this time.
Sure enough, the Glory Empire took action again.
Or quote 500,000 yuan.
Still no one bids, and everyone is already thinking, should they wrap up all the starships?
Then why are you calling us here?
But no matter what they thought, the auction continued.
The third ship, the fourth ship...the ninth ship.
The good news is that Glory Empire stopped selling the fourth ship and no longer makes any bids.
The bad news is that the Knights Alliance and the Business Federation are here again.
Each of these two companies also won three ships.
It was also purchased with a starting price of 500,000, and no one bid against them.
By the time we got to the tenth ship, everyone was already guessing.
When it comes to whether there will be any changes below, the situation is exactly as they expected.
The three major forces have all stopped.
As a researcher of starships, the Magic Empire has already secured the production of the first batch of starships.
Now he appears as the organizer of this auction.
